mapper.select: SELECT a.auction_id, to_char(a.start_time, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS date, a.title, i.file_url AS image, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.status, a.view_count AS guestCount, u.user_name AS hostName, COALESCE(string_agg(t.tag_name, ','), '') AS tags FROM likelist l JOIN auction a ON l.auc_key = a.auction_id LEFT JOIN users u ON a.host_id = u.login_id LEFT JOIN product p ON a.auction_id = p.auc_key LEFT JOIN ( SELECT prod_key, MIN(reg_date) AS min_regdate FROM file GROUP BY prod_key ) fi ON p.prod_key = fi.prod_key LEFT JOIN file i ON i.prod_key = fi.prod_key AND i.reg_date = fi.min_regdate LEFT JOIN auctiontag at ON a.auction_id = at.auc_key LEFT JOIN tag t ON at.tag_key = t.tag_key WHERE l.user_key = #{userKey} GROUP BY a.auction_id, a.start_time, a.title, i.file_url, a.end_time, a.status, a.view_count, u.user_name ORDER BY l.list_key DESC
